chunks: Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili said: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated from Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Ala', from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'foor who said: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said to me:

The Abbasids and the Marwanids will have a battle at Qarqeessiya in which a young boy will grow grey (from the intensity), and Allah will remove victory from them, and He will reveal to the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth: 'Sate yourselves with the flesh of the tyrants.' Then as-Sufyani will emerge.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: As-Sufyani, a major eschatological figure in Shia tradition
key_terms.الْجَبَّارِينَ: The tyrants, referring to the opposing forces in the battle
key_terms.الْمَرْوَانِ: The Marwanid branch of the Umayyad caliphs
key_terms.بَقَرْقِسِيَاءَ: Qarqeessiya, a historical location in Syria

ai.seo_question: What is the battle of Qarqeessiya and who is as-Sufyani?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) foretells a decisive, ferocious battle at Qarqeessiya between the Abbasids and the Marwanids, where divine intervention causes birds and beasts to consume the tyrants' flesh, marking a temporary victory before the rise of the Sufyani. This narration highlights the cosmic scale of the conflict in Shia eschatology, linking terrestrial political struggles with heavenly signs and the eventual emergence of the Sufyani as a precursor to the Mahdi.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (12) Ahmad bin Hawtha al-Bahili narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from al-Husayn bin al-Ala’ from Abdullah bin Abu Ya’foor that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:

“The Abbasids and al-Marwani will meet in Qarqeessiya’ in a terrible battle that causes a young boy to age. Allah will preclude them from gaining victory and will reveal to the birds in the sky and the beasts on the ground to satiate themselves with the flesh of the tyrants. After that as-Sufyani will rise.”
